disease: Cryopyrin-associated periodic syndrome (CAPS / NLRP3-associated autoinflammatory disease)

emergence.disease: Cryopyrin-associated periodic syndrome (CAPS / NLRP3-associated autoinflammatory disease)
emergence.summary: A single-gene NLRP3 gain-of-function. NLRP3 (cryopyrin) is the sensor that nucleates the NLRP3 inflammasome; on activation it recruits the adaptor ASC and pro-caspase-1, and active caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-1beta (and pro-IL-18) to their mature, secreted forms. GOF missense alleles render the inflammasome CONSTITUTIVELY / hyper-active (lowering its activation threshold), so IL-1beta is OVER-produced even without a normal trigger -> the IL-1beta inflammatory drive is pushed UP, giving the CAPS spectrum: familial cold autoinflammatory syndrome (FCAS, cold-induced urticarial rash/fever), Muckle-Wells syndrome (urticaria, sensorineural hearing loss, AA amyloidosis) and the severe neonatal-onset multisystem inflammatory disease (NOMID / CINCA, chronic meningitis, arthropathy, developmental impairment). This is read as a NEW kind of emergent axis for the kit -- an INFLAMMASOME / autoinflammatory (IL-1beta cytokine-drive) axis -- driven UP by an over-active accelerator, so the corrective direction is to RESTRAIN it. The kit re-derives the approved restrain arm: lower the over-produced signal by IL-1 blockade -- canakinumab (an anti-IL-1beta monoclonal antibody that neutralises the mature cytokine), with anakinra (recombinant IL-1 receptor antagonist) and rilonacept (an IL-1 'trap' decoy receptor) as the established alternatives. Direct NLRP3-inflammasome inhibitors are an emerging upstream restrain direction (investigational). Recorded as an IL-1beta OVER-production axis -- the contrast to hereditary angioedema's bradykinin OVER-production: both are axis-UP released/over-driven mediator floods, but on a different mediator (IL-1beta vs bradykinin) with a different lever target (IL-1 blockade vs kallikrein-kinin restraint). The gamma read is of the NLRP3 locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesion is coding (GOF missense in the NACHT domain, e.g. p.Arg260Trp, p.Asp303Asn / p.Asp305Asn region), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: NLRP3-inflammasome IL-1beta drive (caspase-1-processed IL-1beta over-production -> systemic autoinflammation) -- an inflammasome/cytokine axis

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: NLRP3 (cryopyrin; formerly CIAS1) encodes the pattern/danger sensor that nucleates the NLRP3 inflammasome; via ASC it activates caspase-1, which matures pro-IL-1beta to secreted IL-1beta -- the master driver of the autoinflammatory response. CAPS alleles are gain-of-function: they lower the inflammasome's activation threshold so it assembles and fires constitutively -> IL-1beta is over-produced -> the inflammatory drive is pushed UP. As an over-driven ACCELERATOR of IL-1beta output, the pathological axis goes UP and the corrective levers LOWER it. Autosomal dominant (often de novo / somatic mosaic), 1q44 (OMIM 606416). NCBI official symbol NLRP3. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the activating NACHT-domain missense lesions are outside the promoter firewall.
per_gene.src: Hoffman 2001 Nat Genet 29:301 (CIAS1/NLRP3 mutations cause FCAS and Muckle-Wells); Aksentijevich 2002 Arthritis Rheum 46:3340 (NOMID/CINCA); Agostini 2004 Immunity 20:319 (cryopyrin inflammasome activates caspase-1 / IL-1beta)

treatment_A_switch.disease: Cryopyrin-associated periodic syndrome (CAPS / NLRP3-associated autoinflammatory disease)

levers.push_direction: neutralise the over-produced IL-1beta -> lower the inflammasome-driven inflammatory drive (axis DOWN toward healthy)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of IL-1beta neutralisation / inflammation control not derived from sequence
levers.src: Lachmann 2009 NEJM 360:2416 (canakinumab beta-Confident, CAPS); canakinumab (Ilaris) FDA 2009 / EMA 2009

levers.push_direction: block the IL-1 receptor with the receptor antagonist so IL-1beta cannot signal -> lower the inflammatory drive
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of IL-1 signalling blockade not derived from sequence

levers.push_direction: trap circulating IL-1 with a decoy-receptor fusion so less reaches its receptor -> lower the inflammatory drive
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of IL-1 sequestration not derived from sequence
levers.src: Hoffman 2008 Arthritis Rheum 58:2443 (rilonacept in CAPS); rilonacept (Arcalyst)

levers.push_direction: inhibit the NLRP3 inflammasome directly upstream -> less caspase-1 activation -> less IL-1beta produced -> lower the inflammatory drive (definitive, upstream)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] potency / inflammasome-suppression magnitude not derived from sequence
levers.src: Coll 2015 Nat Med 21:248 (MCC950, a selective NLRP3 inhibitor)

lead_corrective_lever.push_direction: neutralise the over-produced IL-1beta -> lower the inflammasome-driven inflammatory drive (axis DOWN toward healthy)
lead_corrective_lever.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of IL-1beta neutralisation / inflammation control not derived from sequence
lead_corrective_lever.src: Lachmann 2009 NEJM 360:2416 (canakinumab beta-Confident, CAPS); canakinumab (Ilaris) FDA 2009 / EMA 2009

modelling.grade: [F] ordering forced (over-shoot) ; delta/treat_frac documented choices ; realised magnitude [O]

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: NLRP3 GOF (over-active inflammasome accelerator) raises IL-1beta over-production (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: a CAPS NLRP3 GOF allele that LOWERED inflammasome assembly / caspase-1 activation / IL-1beta secretion would refute the over-driven-accelerator direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: ASC-speck formation, caspase-1 activation and mature IL-1beta secretion from NLRP3-mutant vs wild-type monocytes / macrophages

falsifiers.claim: restraining IL-1 (IL-1 blockade) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the inflammatory drive)
falsifiers.falsifier: if neutralising IL-1beta, blocking the IL-1 receptor, or trapping IL-1 RAISED or failed to lower the autoinflammatory readouts, the restrain lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: CRP / SAA inflammatory markers and clinical attack/flare activity response to an IL-1-blocking agent in CAPS

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
